name: Next.js image remotePatterns/domains wildcard host
attack_scenario: attacker requests /_next/image?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ (host allowed by '**'); the server-side optimizer fetches internal metadata and relays the response
negative_test_hint: request "/_next/image?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/" and assert the optimizer refuses to fetch it instead of relaying the metadata response

exemplar.explanation: A fully-wildcard hostname ('*' or '**') turns the Next.js image optimizer into an open image proxy that fetches and re-serves any URL an attacker supplies, enabling SSRF and bandwidth abuse. The pattern anchors to a quote immediately closing the wildcard, so intended single-level subdomain wildcards like '*.example.com' do NOT match.
